lookback_summary: Well, it was a mixed bag for the model this weekend! It did nail the prediction for Fulham vs Man United, calling the draw correctly, and also got it right with Man City’s home win over Sunderland. But it had to eat humble pie on the Leeds vs Crystal Palace match, where it thought Leeds would take the points at home, only for it to end in a stalemate. The model also missed the mark with Everton, predicting a loss when they actually managed to secure a home win against Ipswich. On the flip side, it correctly anticipated Liverpool's away victory at Bournemouth and Newcastle's solid performance against Hull City, which was a nice touch given the banker status. Overall, a decent weekend but definitely some surprises that left us scratching our heads!
